quest.title: Roasted by Flames
quest.description: As Escoffier promised, a fiery culinary showdown is about to begin...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x450, Mora x38100, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: ...Mesdames et Messieurs! Welcome, one and all, to the Hotel Debord and to this most exciting of cooking contests!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Savanna, I've brought the original copy of the Codex you asked for.

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: ...Monica? Hmph...

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Mmph...

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: In the interests of fairness, this contest will be conducted in a double-blind format. Once the dishes are complete, they will be sent to the back of the kitchen, where they'll each receive a label.

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: The labels will be placed out of sight underneath the plates, only to be revealed after the judges have sampled them and reached a final verdict. This is to ensure that no one will know which dish is made by which contestant.

dialogues.speaker: Eloise
dialogues.text: ...As one of the judges, I promise to be fair and impartial.

dialogues.speaker: Renaud
dialogues.text: Heh, when my meal got interrupted yesterday, I never thought this is how they'd make it up to me! Getting a seat on the judging panel is a pretty sweet deal!

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: Both contestants have taken their positions. Then, without further ado: Let the Hotel Debord cooking contest... commence!

talks.objective: Make the first tier of cake

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: Time's up! Contestants, please take your dishes to the back.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... That guy was right. You really can't tell whose is whose just by looking at them.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: We both made the same dish, after all. For all her flaws, Savanna's a talented chef who earned my recommendation for good reason. She wouldn't screw up something as elementary as the cake's appearance.

dialogues.speaker: Renaud
dialogues.text: Whoa! This is really rather good!

dialogues.speaker: Eloise
dialogues.text: Wonderfully soft and fluffy, beautifully sweet... This is a masterclass in how to make Gateau Debord!

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: ...Hmph.

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: I would give this one at least... nine point nine out of ten!

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: Only because there's something about the flavor of the base... It's just a little different from the recipe I'm used to...

dialogues.speaker: Renaud
dialogues.text: Huh? Really? I couldn't tell...

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: ...Tch!

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: Haha, alright — onto gateau number two! ...Mmm... I haven't had a single bite, and already this aroma is a delight to the senses!

dialogues.speaker: Eloise
dialogues.text: I have a feeling that this gateau will be a gateau for the ages!

dialogues.speaker: Renaud
dialogues.text: How exciting! ...I'm gonna dig in!

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: Huh...

dialogues.speaker: Eloise
dialogues.text: Hmm...?

dialogues.speaker: Renaud
dialogues.text: Uhh... I think, maybe... someone got a little carried away when they were adding the sugar?

dialogues.speaker: Eloise
dialogues.text: Not just the sugar — it's the flavors too. This is all over the place... Who made this!?

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: *sigh*... It appears the decision is unanimous. This gateau is far below the standard we would expect.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... And Paimon thought this might actually be close. Turns out, she can't bake to save her life!

choices.text: Maybe it's because of poor teamwork?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: ...Something's not right here. Savanna may not be perfect, but no way is she this sloppy...

response.speaker: Vaneigem
response.text: I can now declare that the creator of the first gateau has won this cooking contest. Now, all that remains is to turn the plate over, and reveal the chef's name underneath...

response.speaker: Renaud
response.text: Wha... It's... Savanna!?

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: No... that's impossible!

response.speaker: Savanna
response.text: Hmph.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Savanna! You cheated, didn't you? You cheater!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What did you do? ...Oh, you swapped the plates, didn't you!

response.speaker: Savanna
response.text: Well, someone's a sore loser. These cakes went from the oven to the judges' table without me ever laying a finger on them, and everyone here can attest to that.

response.speaker: Savanna
response.text: It was Vaneigem's staff who labelled them in the kitchen. If you're looking to accuse someone, why don't you start with them?

response.speaker: Savanna
response.text: Isn't it more likely that Escoffier's lost her edge? Oh, or maybe her assistants let the team down?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You take that back!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Judges! We demand a rematch!

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: That's enough... What's done is done.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: As head chef... or rather, as team lead, I take responsibility for the dish I served. Whatever went wrong, and however it happened, I should have spotted it.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Savanna... I didn't think you'd stoop this low just to beat me in a bake-off... What happened to your chef's pride?

response.speaker: Savanna
response.text: I... I don't know what you're talking about!

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: If you want the Codex Debord that much, you can have it.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: ...Escoffier, no!

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: But you must promise me that you'll apologize to Firmin, and compensate him for everything you put him through!

response.speaker: Savanna
response.text: It's a little late to be negotiating terms... The contest is over, and I won. That means you owe me the Codex, and I owe you nothing!

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Look, Savanna, you may have fooled everyone else, but can you really fool yourself? What I'm offering is to accept defeat without looking to expose what you've done...

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: ...But only on the condition that you promise to stop putting so much pressure on your staff.

response.speaker: Savanna
response.text: ...Hmph, fine. I'll treat this as your final handover of duties from one head chef to the next.

response.speaker: Savanna
response.text: So will that be all, ex-head chef? Or is there any other unfinished business you'd like to leave in my hands?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: I didn't mean that to be a scolding from your former boss. Just a word of advice from a fellow chef... and a friend.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: But I don't know if you're even open to input from other people anymore.

response.speaker: Savanna
response.text: I know what I'm doing... I don't need your advice!

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Alright, fine. I'm glad to hear it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah... Escoffier!

response.speaker: Savanna
response.text: The Codex Debord! Finally! Now, at long last, I will succeed!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Escoffier! How could you let her get away with this?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! The Codex is a souvenir of your time here... Doesn't that mean anything to you?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: ...It's alright. It was just a bake-off, not the end of the world. I'm already over it.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Besides, it's not all bad — she agreed to compensate Firmin. That's mission accomplished for the Spina.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Honestly, if I'd known that giving her the Codex would solve everything, I'd have just done that in the first place. I mean, why bother with a whole cooking contest? It's such a waste of time and energy!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Privately, I'm sure she's devastated. But what's done is done...)

response.speaker: Savanna
response.text: No... No! This doesn't make any sense!

response.speaker: Alphonse
response.text: Hmm?

response.speaker: Savanna
response.text: That's... that's it? No secrets, no nothing? I don't believe it... This can't be happening!

response.speaker: Gaspard
response.text: ...Chef Savanna!

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Savanna...!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Savanna passes out after reading through the original Codex...

response.speaker: Vaneigem
response.text: *sigh*... It's nothing life-threatening. Just a lot of pent-up stress and exhaustion.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Ugh... I knew it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Pent-up stress? ...Her?

response.speaker: Alphonse
response.text: The truth is... however hard she might be on the rest of us, the person she puts the most pressure on is herself...

response.speaker: Gaspard
response.text: Yes, there are nights when she makes us redo things over and over into the wee hours... but for her, it's every night.

response.speaker: Gaspard
response.text: ...She'll hide herself away in the kitchen, working on new techniques and recipes, and only realize how long she's been at it when we come to work the following morning.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: But... why? Why would she do that?

response.speaker: Alphonse
response.text: Our best guess is... She doesn’t want to be seen as less of a chef than Escoffier.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: And there it is.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Even so... that's no excuse for taking her anger out on the rest of you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! And it's definitely no excuse for cheating in the cooking contest!

response.speaker: Gaspard
response.text: Um, about that... We honestly have no idea how she did it. We were focused on our own work the whole time, like she asked...

response.speaker: Vaneigem
response.text: Leone and Argalia were the ones I tasked with labeling the cakes. I've already spoken to them both — they're at a loss to explain it, too.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Not to worry... Come on, join me downstairs. I'll interrogate the guilty gateau myself!

choices.text: She spent half the time just berating her staff...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Well, how is it? Have you figured out what it was?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: ...Ugh, this is aggravated assault on my palate! I'd rather eat wet cement than this!

dialogues.speaker: Alphonse
dialogues.text: Uh, i—is it really that bad? I made sure to taste-test it before it was served...

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Relax, this isn't your cake. Savanna never switched the plates.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: The offending flavors are coming from in between the icing and the cake base... Which means, someone tampered with it while it was being made.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Or in other words... we have a traitor in our midst.

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: ...I'm sorry! I—I was forced into it!

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: It was Chef Savanna! She said... if I didn't cooperate, she would... she would...

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Calm down, Monica! I've already accepted defeat, and if I wanted retribution, I would have brought this up when the results were announced.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Whatever's going on with you, just spill the beans. There's no need to hide it.

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: *sigh*... I was the one who caused the food safety incident that one time.

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: Food safety... Wait, you mean the lumiline incident!? So YOU procured the contaminated ingredients?

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: I—I think so... Savanna and I were on procurement that day. I didn't check everything as well as I should have, and so... I let contaminated ingredients make it into the kitchen...

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: But I swear, I didn't do it on purpose! I had no idea there was an issue with them, and I didn't know it would end up with Escoffier going to jail!

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: ...But the last thing I expected was for Savanna to use it as leverage to blackmail me with...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is crazy... So, Savanna pressured you into sabotaging Escoffier's cake by threatening to expose your secret if you didn't?

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: I know, it's terrible... I'm so sorry! I just... I was so scared! The thought of Chef Escoffier finding out that I put her in jail... it made me freeze up with fear...

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: I thought Escoffier would hate my guts if she ever found out... And yet somehow, that's ended up in me doing something even worse! I... I... *sob*

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Seriously... All this fuss over a little slip-up?

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: ...Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Firstly, it's not like I got a life sentence. I did my stint at the Fortress, and now I'm out. Secondly... I had my own reasons for leaving the Hotel Debord, this wasn't the only factor.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: So you don't need to feel ashamed, or frightened, or anything like that — any more than you need to add butter when you're pan searing foie gras.

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: You mean... you forgive me?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Oh... Well, I'm not saying you don't have to take responsibility for your mistakes.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: You should tell Vaneigem to mark down your performance for the past few months, then do some digging and find out exactly where those contaminated ingredients came from. Sure, you've made mistakes, but now's the time to fix them. Understood?

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: U—Understood!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Good. Now, back to Savanna... What about the original Codex would compel her to resort to blackmail?

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Um... I have my suspicions, not that I've got any proof to back them up though...

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: Ugh... What happened to me...?

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: I've overheard some customers murmuring about how the Hotel Debord hasn't been the same since Escoffier left. They think our menu doesn't taste like it used to... especially our signature items.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You mean, Gateau Debord?

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it... I noticed it during the contest, too. I couldn't put my finger on it, but the flavor seemed subtly different from how it used to be...

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: ...But the difference was so small, I'm sure no one would notice it besides our most loyal customers and true dessert connoisseurs.

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Still, as head chef, it's easy to see why Savanna would get so hung up on it.

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: So many times, I've seen her make the cake base over and over again, late into the night, determined to match Escoffier's version. But something's always slightly off every time...

dialogues.speaker: Alphonse
dialogues.text: Yeah, I've noticed that, too... Never really gave it much thought, though.

dialogues.speaker: Gaspard
dialogues.text: Thinking back on it now... it's clear that Savanna's been in a downward spiral ever since Escoffier left.

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: She wants to prove that she can fill Escoffier's shoes. That's gotta be the reason.

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: But after countless setbacks, she's getting more and more unhinged.

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: And at some point along the way, she switched from doubting herself... to doubting Escoffier.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Doubting Escoffier? For what?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...She thought the Codex from Escoffier was a fake.

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Yeah, it would explain why she was bent on getting the original at any cost. She must have thought Escoffier purposely omitted key details from her recipes when she copied them out...

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: All so she could retain her place as the number one chef in Fontaine... the only one privy to all the secrets of the trade.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Oh for goodness' sake! What a stupid idea!

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Of course, then she finally got the Codex, only to discover that the secret recipes she's been pining for don't exist at all...

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Seeing how utterly wrong she was must have been a real shock to the system. It probably brought up everything at once, it overwhelmed her, and she passed out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's still one thing that doesn't make sense, though... If Savanna had the real recipe all along, how come it tasted different?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She might not be on the same level as Escoffier, but surely after, like, fifty attempts, she'd get it right one of those times?

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: You'd think so, but... geniuses like Escoffier are in a league of their own.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "...She's keeping the true recipe to herself..."

dialogues.speaker: Customers in Spirited Discussion
dialogues.text: ...New head chef, you say? What's her name? ...Hmm, I don't think I've heard of her before...

dialogues.speaker: Customers in Spirited Discussion
dialogues.text: ...I wonder, can the Hotel Debord keep its edge without Escoffier at the helm?

dialogues.speaker: Customers in Spirited Discussion
dialogues.text: This tastes different from last time... Is it undercooked, or something?

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: ...Argh!!!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "...Get your hands on the Codex... no matter what it takes!"

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Take this. It's a copy of the Codex Debord. From now on, you will be its keeper.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Don't listen to the doubters. If I say you can do it, then you can do it! Even if you don't believe in yourself, at least believe in me.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Hey! Did you hear me? ...Once I'm gone, the restaurant is all yours.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "...So YOU let the lumiline into the kitchen?"

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: All this time, I've been blaming other people, but maybe... I'm the problem...

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: ...I sincerely apologize for putting everyone out. Savanna's awake now, but... I don't think she's ready to speak to anyone yet.

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: Let's give her the day to calm down. I'm sure you'll have the chance to talk everything out tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: In that case, I'll go and update Firmin and his family. I wonder what he'll make of all this...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #So... {NICKNAME}, we'll come back tomorrow, then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure. Let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Phew... That was a long day. I think I've earned myself a sweet treat when I get back home...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, nice. Macarons? Or are you gonna switch it up this time?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: #...{NICKNAME}, how much do you know about the Snow-Winged Goose?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: ...Every year, they migrate long distances in search of a suitable home. There's always one goose at the front, whose job is to lead the flock...

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Fontaine poets often use the image of that goose to explore the ideas about leadership and genius. They usually imagine someone who's a cut above the rest, a model of perfection...

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: But what those poets don't know is that during a migration, the lead goose is always changing.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Once the lead goose shows signs of fatigue, it retreats to the back of the flock, and allows another goose to take its place.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: So the truth is that leadership, with all the responsibilities and pressures that come with it — it's something that everyone takes turns at. But we humans completely miss that fact when we project our own ideas about social hierarchies onto them.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is this about... you and Savanna?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Heh... I guess what I'm saying is, I don't buy into this notion that there's some sort of gulf between "normal" and "genius."

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Cooking is a science, not magic. Given the same ingredients, same recipe, and same environment, I see no reason why two different people shouldn't be able to create the exact same dish.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Of course, some people have a more sensitive palate than others, and some people are just born bolder or more conscientious... But these are all variables that can be accounted for with time and practice.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: I'd have no reason to expect so much from others if I believed that perfection can only come from the hands of a genius. The only reason I hold people to high standards is because... well, I believe they're capable of greatness.

choices.text: I don't know if you're right...

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: #Hmm... Okay, I've made up my mind, {NICKNAME}. I'm gonna get to the bottom of why Savanna failed.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: And come tomorrow, I'll give her the scolding of her life, pointing out all the mistakes she's made along the way. Then she'll finally see the error of her ways!

choices.text: But I think that's a great thing to believe in.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: ...Let's hope that Savanna isn't all sizzle and no steak. After all the work we've put in... it would kinda be a shame if tomorrow was a complete cakewalk.

dialogues.speaker: Hotel Debord Notice
dialogues.text: The Strongest Chef of Today vs. The Strongest Chef in History! A legendary contest of mastery over Hotel Debord's legendary dish, the Gateau Debord, is about to commence! The prize — custodianship over the Codex Debord!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's cooking contest day! To the Hotel Debord, tout suite!

dialogues.speaker: Customers in Spirited Discussion
dialogues.text: Did you hear the news? Escoffier's coming back for a cooking contest!

dialogues.speaker: Customers in Spirited Discussion
dialogues.text: Wait, seriously? Escoffier, in a cooking contest? Now that, I've got to see!

dialogues.speaker: Customers in Spirited Discussion
dialogues.text: I don't get it... Why would anyone in their right mind challenge her to a cooking contest?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: #Monica, {NICKNAME}, it's go time. Let's do this!

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: Alphonse, Gaspard, get to work! Do not disappoint me!

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: Haha! Looks like our two head chefs are raring to go! Like an oven on full blast, this competition is quickly heating up...

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: Alphonse! What are you playing at!? That's not how I taught you to do it! Stop horsing around, and do it again!

dialogues.speaker: Alphonse
dialogues.text: Y—Yes, Chef!

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: Ooh... Tension in the ranks on team Savanna... Will this slow their progress?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: (For goodness' sake, Savanna, what are you doing? ...Ugh, forget it. I've gotta focus on my own dish...)

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: Escoffier is already on the final step of the recipe! Let's check on Savanna's progress...

dialogues.speaker: Gaspard
dialogues.text: Hmm... I think this flavor profile is still a little bit off!

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: Enough! Ugh, useless... Both of you, make like an egg and beat it! I'll do it myself!

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: Wow! Is Savanna serious? Can she really make up for lost time working alone?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: ...Even the best chef in the world can't flavor their food without prepping the flavoring, right?
